original.target_description: Experiment 1, visual perspective, p. 212 (article p. 2). Broad age-comparison locator does not distinguish age-specific one-sample tests against chance from within-age sign tests comparing there/where trials. No direct between-age inferential test is reported in this results section.

notes: Identity verified independently from cover and article: Nurmsoo, Erika and Bloom, Paul (2008), Psychological Science 19(3), 211–215; DOI 10.1111/j.1467-9280.2008.02069.x; cover calls document Publisher pdf. Article title/byline match, including additional subtitle Do They Blindly Follow Eye Gaze? Canonical text includes full five-page primary report and references. No PDF supplied. Candidate tests: older and younger there-trial one-sample ts(31) = 4.48 and 3.00, respectively, with printed p_rep .996 and .97; older where-trial one-sample t(31) = 3.23 with printed p_rep .97; within-age sign tests comparing visible-object choices on there versus where trials, ps < .05, with no printed sign-test statistic. No direct between-age inferential test reported. Cannot identify a unique target from broad age-comparison description. Preserve p_rep as its own printed metric, without conversion into ordinary p. Canonical text renders equals as 5. Candidate experiment total: 32 older + 32 younger = 64 participants in mutually exclusive age groups, but no pooled target critical model established. Age-specific tests remain candidates. No N derived from df. All assigned values null, target_match null, confidence false; replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
